name: mnote_create_note
description: Create a note. `title` is the note title; `body` is the content as plain MARKDOWN (headings, lists, code fences, tables, task lists) — write clean, well-structured markdown. `categories` is an optional array of category ids to tag it with (from mnote_list_categories). The slug is derived from the title (auto-deduped) unless you pass `slug` explicitly — do that when creating a note that existing notes already link to (a `broken` target from mnote_links), so those links resolve. Notes LINK to each other with `[[slug]]`, or `[[slug|Display Text]]` to choose the wording — written inline in the markdown body, Obsidian-style. Prefer a link over restating another note's content. Get slugs from mnote_list_notes. Linking to a slug that doesn't exist yet is allowed and shows as a to-be-created link. Never put `|` or `]` inside the display text — it silently breaks the link. Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the created note including its new slug.

categories.description: Optional category ids to tag the note with.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug. Use it to create the note that an existing `[[link]]` points at (a `broken` target from mnote_links), so those links resolve. Otherwise the slug comes from the title.
